name: winter-demo
description: A Winter terminal in a webview, painted by Winter's own renderer.

commands.title: Winter: Show What the Program Asked For

winter.addonPath.description: Path to winter.node, the addon this extension calls. Defaults to winter.node beside the extension, which `npm run build:addon` writes.

winter.fontSize.description: The point size the terminal measures its face at. Takes effect on the next opened terminal.

winter.shell.description: Program the terminal runs. Defaults to PowerShell on Windows (7 before 5.1) and $SHELL on macOS and Linux.

scripts.build: npm run build:addon && npm run compile
